title: Add Alibi to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Alibi](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-alibi) to games
- A voice murder mystery. Four AI suspects, each with their own voice and story: question them out loud (or type), keep a notebook of what each one claims, catch the contradiction in the culprit's alibi

Fixes #15740, fixes #15724

gist.headline: Four suspects, one bad alibi
gist.blurb: Alibi joins the games collection: question four AI suspects by voice or text, take notes, and find the story that doesn’t add up. Detective work, minus the trench coat requirement.
gist.summary: Added Alibi to the games collection, a voice murder mystery where players question four voiced AI suspects, record their claims in a notebook, and identify the culprit through a contradictory alibi.
gist.impact: Players get a mystery they can investigate out loud or by typing, with a notebook to help compare all four suspects’ stories.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Alibi as a cozy detective game: Polli, wearing a tiny detective hat, compares four distinct suspect portrait cards and voice-wave symbols against notes in an open notebook. A small flower and a code-plant soften the mystery setting; keep it playful rather than ominous.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art detective nook, Polli in a tiny detective hat studies an open notebook beside four distinct suspect portrait cards and little speech-wave icons, with a flower and a code-plant growing by the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, never oversized, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow against warm cream and lavender, and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
